subject: Re: POC Trial - Model selection & success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Lee <daniel.lee@greenleaf.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed POC plan (model selection)

Hi Daniel — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can kick off the POC smoothly.

Call highlights / success criteria (as discussed)
- Primary goal: reach production-quality summarization and conversational accuracy for mortgage customer support workflows (intent detection + slot extraction + concise answer generation).
- Success metrics: intent accuracy >= 90% on your annotated test set; end-to-end latency p95 < 350ms for single-turn queries; acceptable hallucination rate (metadata recall >= 85% on benchmark prompts).
- Multilingual: English + Spanish support are required for the POC. French is optional.

Model candidates (initial proposal)
- Primary: Llama-2-70B (8-bit quantized) — best balance of instruction-following quality and multilingual transfer for English/Spanish prompts.
- Fallback/fast path: Mistral-Instruct-13B (quantized) — lower cost and faster latency; will be used for high-throughput non-critical routes and as a fallback during capacity constraints.
- Note: we will evaluate both in zero-shot and light prompt-engineered settings; if needed, we can run a small alignment/fine-tune step on your 2k-label sample set.

Evaluation plan & timeline
- Week 0 (prep): you share sample_prompts.csv + S3 read access to labeled test set.
- Week 1 (bench): Redwood runs automated evals (latency, token cost, accuracy, hallucination tests) on both model variants against your test set.
- Week 2 (iter): iterate on prompt templates and small few-shot examples; produce final recommendation and handoff plan.

Owners / next steps
- Redwood: Marissa (engagement owner), Aditya (SE — will run the benchmarks and config model variants), Vivek (customer success).
- GreenLeaf: Daniel (POC lead) — please confirm dataset access and whether we should include any redact/PII rules in the evaluation.

Can you confirm the dataset availability and whether the latency requirement above (p95 < 350ms) is a hard SLO for the POC? If good, we’ll schedule a kickoff for the week of Aug 3 and share a short PoC plan doc and onboarding checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.
—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142
Redwood Inference

From: Daniel Lee <daniel.lee@greenleaf.com>

Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed POC plan (model selection)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the thorough recap. Quick answers and one ask:

- Dataset: we can share sample_prompts.csv and a labeled test set (~2,500 rows) via temporary S3 credentials. Will share S3 link by EOD today.
- Latency: p95 < 350ms is our target for customer-facing single-turn queries; for background batch jobs higher latency is acceptable. So yes, treat it as a primary POC requirement.
- Multilingual: Spanish test set included (~20% of traffic). We do NOT need fine-tuning initially — prompt engineering is preferred.
- Compliance: we have a brief security questionnaire; can your SE team sign an NDA and fetch basic SOC2 evidence? I can send the questionnaire now.

One more thing — could you include a small set of cold-start long-context prompts (4–6 turns) in the sample file? We want to see behaviour on conversation history as well.

Sending S3 link in a separate email.

Thanks,
Daniel

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Lee <daniel.lee@greenleaf.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed POC plan (model selection)

Thanks Daniel — good clarifications. Technical plan / evaluation details from our side:

Metrics we will measure
- Accuracy: intent classification (micro-F1), slot extraction F1, end-to-end answer correctness (human-sampled) — target intent acc >= 90%.
- Latency: p50/p95 token-level latency and end-to-end response time; target p95 < 350ms for single-turn queries measured from API entry to final token.
- Cost: tokens-per-response and estimated $/1000 queries. We’ll include per-route cost profiles.
- Hallucination/recall: precision on knowledge snippets; we’ll include a hallucination score on the labeled set.

Model configuration & infra notes
- Llama-2-70B (8-bit quantized): primary; will use Redwood’s optimized kernels, continuous batching, and KV cache for multi-turn paths. Expect higher quality on edge cases and better Spanish transfer with prompt engineering.
- Mistral-Instruct-13B (quantized): fallback and fast-path for high throughput. Lower memory and better p95 in low-latency pooling.
- We’ll also run a lightweight ablation where we enable prefix caching for the top intents to measure cost reductions.

Data access & security
- Please grant S3 read access to redwood-poc@redwood-inference (we’ll only read the test bucket). We’ll complete your questionnaire — Marissa, can you share the NDA and SOC2 evidence link?

Timeline
- Aug 3: kickoff and env setup (credentials, ingestion of sample_prompts.csv).
- Aug 4–10: bench both models on your test set + report.
- Aug 11–14: iterate on prompts and provide final recommendation.

Deliverables
- Weekly status note, bench report (latency, cost, accuracy), and final recommendation with suggested production config (quantization, batching, fallback routing).

If that looks good I’ll prepare the benchmark job configs now so we can start immediately after S3 access.


Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

Daniel — confirming we’re good to proceed and have scheduled the kickoff for Aug 3 (technical kickoff notes will be in the linked PoC plan). Summary:

- Kickoff date: Aug 3 (setup, credentials ingestion).
- Trial window: Aug 3–Aug 14 (2-week evaluation).
- Owners: Marissa (Engagement/coordination), Aditya (Benchmarks/SE), Vivek (CS escalation/config), Daniel (GreenLeaf POC lead).
- Models to test: Llama-2-70B (8-bit quant) primary; Mistral-Instruct-13B fallback.
- Multilingual: will include English + Spanish test sets; we will run prompt-engineering first and flag if light tuning is required.

Attachments / links: poc_plan.pdf, sample_prompts.csv (from Daniel), HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.company/contacts/GLF-2026-042

Action items for GreenLeaf:
- Provide S3 read access by EOD Jul 29 (Daniel to confirm).
- Confirm who on your side will validate the final accuracy samples (we typically ask for 10–20 human checks).

We’ll circulate the kickoff calendar invite and the short PoC checklist shortly. If anything changes on your side (dataset or scope), let us know so we can adjust the bench.
